hero.headline: The home sauna with nothing hidden before checkout
hero.subhead: The price, the power it needs and what arrives at your door, stated up front so you can decide without a sales call.

checked_claims.ad_said: Sauna shopping used to be confusing.
checked_claims.fact: The Fuji page lists its capacity, cabin wood and heat range before you buy: two people, Canadian red cedar, up to 150°F.
The Fuji runs on a 120V / 20A dedicated outlet; a standard 15A outlet is not sufficient.
Assembled, the cabin measures 53 inches wide, 44 inches deep and 75 inches high.
Infrared heaters cover near, mid and far wavelengths, from 700 to 25,000nm.
Medical-grade red light therapy is included standard, with one panel you sit facing from about seven to eight inches away.
Every order ships free. In-stock orders leave the warehouse within a few business days, and heavy freight arrives on a delivery appointment you schedule.

questions.question: Do I need special wiring?
questions.answer: You need a 120V / 20A dedicated outlet. A standard 15A outlet is not sufficient, so check your panel before ordering.

questions.question: How many people fit inside?
questions.answer: Two people sit side by side on one bench.

questions.question: How hot does the cabin get?
questions.answer: The Fuji reaches up to 150°F, with heaters placed around you so the warmth reaches your back, sides and legs, not just the front.

questions.question: What happens if I change my mind?
questions.answer: Returns are accepted once the cabin is taken apart and repacked in its original crate.

closing.headline: See the Fuji with every number on the page
